name: Data Privacy
description: Personal data handling, lawful basis, individual rights and breach readiness.

items.text: Personal data processed by the project is inventoried
items.guidance: Record data categories, sources, systems and recipients.

items.text: Special-category or sensitive data is identified and flagged
items.guidance: Health, biometric and financial data need additional safeguards.

items.text: Data flows, including cross-border transfers, are mapped
items.guidance: Confirm a valid transfer mechanism for each international flow.

items.text: A lawful basis is documented for each processing purpose
items.guidance: Avoid relying on consent where another basis is more appropriate.

items.text: Privacy notice is updated to reflect the processing
items.guidance: Use plain language and publish before data collection begins.

items.text: A privacy impact assessment is completed for high-risk processing
items.guidance: Consult the privacy officer before go-live.

items.text: Process exists to handle access, correction and deletion requests
items.guidance: Track requests against statutory response deadlines.

items.text: Retention periods are defined and deletion is automated
items.guidance: Keep data no longer than necessary for its purpose.

items.text: Data minimisation is applied to collection forms and logs
items.guidance: Remove optional fields that are not needed.

items.text: Breach notification procedure meets regulatory timelines
items.guidance: Some regimes require notification within 72 hours.

items.text: Processors are bound by data processing agreements
items.guidance: Include breach notification and sub-processor obligations.
